info.name: Ember API (local)
info.description:
Ember API routes for local dev.

BASE URL: {{baseUrl}} = http://localhost:3000 (the Next dev app, which reads the LOCAL Supabase stack).

AUTH: authenticated routes use Supabase's SSR cookie session, NOT a bearer token. In Postman, open the app in a logged-in browser, copy the full `Cookie` request header (DevTools > Application > Cookies > http://localhost:3000, or a request whose Host is localhost:3000), and paste it into the `authCookie` collection variable. The authenticated + admin requests send it via a `Cookie` header.

VARIABLES: set `facilityId`, `alertId`, `notificationId`, `cronSecret` once and the requests pick them up.

MIN NIGHTS: `minNights` (camelCase in bodies -> min_nights column) is an integer between 1 and the watch-window length. POST /api/alerts and PATCH /api/alerts/{id} accept it; GET /api/alerts returns min_nights. The cron matcher still branches on `flexibility` — switching it to min_nights is the remaining piece of the rework.

request.description: Cabin-name autocomplete over the cabins table. Returns up to 8: { cabins: [{ id, name, area }] }.
Proxies Recreation.gov RIDB facilities + recareas search. Requires RIDB_API_KEY server-side. Returns { facilities, areas } raw.

query.description: optional YYYY-MM; defaults to current month

request.description: Live Recreation.gov availability for one facility + month. 400 if facilityId missing, 502 if rec.gov unreachable.
The signed-in user's non-cancelled alerts (now including min_nights), joined with cabin name/area. 401 if not authenticated.

Create a cancellation (or reminder) alert.

Fields: type (cancellation|reminder), dateFrom/dateTo (YYYY-MM-DD), minNights (integer 1..window length — min consecutive available nights that trigger a cancellation alert), flexibility (strict|flexible — legacy, being replaced by minNights), notifyWhen (1day|1week, reminders), notificationMethod (email|sms).

Returns { ok, email, alertId }. Errors: 400 missing fields / invalid_min_nights, 409 duplicate / overlap.

Update the minimum-nights threshold on one of the user's alerts. minNights: integer >= 1 and <= the alert's window length (upper bound enforced by the DB constraint; returns 400 invalid_min_nights otherwise). This same endpoint also accepts { status: "cancelled" } to cancel.
Soft-cancel one of the user's alerts. Accepts { status: "cancelled" } (and/or { minNights }); status must be "cancelled".
Dismiss a notification (opening) so it leaves 'Needs Attention'. Visibility-only; row stays. Only { dismissed: true } accepted.
Force-send the availability email for YOUR alert immediately (skips the checker + rec.gov). Does not write a notifications row. Returns { ok, email, dateRange }.
Operator tool: force-send for ANY alert to its owner (or add "email": "override@x.com" to the body). 403 unless the session email equals EMBER_ADMIN_EMAIL. Returns { ok, email, dateRange, alertId }.

Polls rec.gov for all active cancellation alerts and emails matches. Requires Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET> in prod; in non-prod it is allowed without the header when CRON_SECRET is unset. Returns { ok, openings, sent, duplicate, failed }.
